Group is a global hospitality company that owns and/or manages more than 50 hotels, resorts and serviced suites across three brands – Pan Pacific, PARKROYAL COLLECTION, and PARKROYAL – encompassing more than 30 cities across Asia Pacific, Africa, North America and Europe. Headquartered in Singapore, it is a member of Singapore-listed UOL Group Limited . Pan Pacific Hotels and Resorts delivers sincere and graceful service to every guest with a passion for excellence. PARKROYAL COLLECTION Hotels & Resorts is driven by our passion for life and sustainability. PARKROYAL Hotels & Resorts is distinguished by its passion for people and places, immersing every guest into local and authentic cultures. Pan Pacific Pan Pacific Hotels and Resorts is the embodiment of gracious and genuine hospitality that delivers personalised and thoughtful experiences with intuitive and sincere service from the heart. At Pan Pacific, we believe that true luxury hospitality is always sincere and trustworthy. Find Out More PARKROYAL COLLECTION PARKROYAL COLLECTION Hotels & Resorts are icons of biophilic and innovative design that enriches a sense of wellbeing with a strong connection with nature, delivering inspiring experiences. At PARKROYAL COLLECTION, we are passionate for living life without compromising on sustainability. Find Out More PARKROYAL PARKROYAL Hotels & Resorts creates a modern way of travel to discover genuine connections with the neighbourhood, and a sense of belonging to the destination in their true selves. At PARKROYAL, the joy in simplicity and authenticity is in our name. Find Out More In addition, the Group also manages: St. Gregory Award-winning spas located in Singapore, Malaysia, Myanmar, China and Vietnam. Find Out More Si Chuan Dou Hua Award-winning restaurants serving up authentic Sichuan and Cantonese cuisines across Asia. Find Out More Our Leaders Our leadership comprises a team of experienced individuals dedicated to spearheading the Group’s numerous business efforts across the globe. Choe Peng Sum Chief Executive Officer Peng Sum has more than 30 years of experience in the hospitality industry from multiple destinations across Asia and Europe. As CEO, he leads the Group’s global operations and expansion, with its commitment to delivering trusted and sincere hospitality. He is a member of the Board of Directors for Pan Pacific Hotels Group and Global Hotel Alliance. Wee Wei Ling Executive Director of Sustainability Partnerships, Lifestyle and Asset Wei Ling joined the Group more than 30 years ago and is responsible for its sustainability strategy, as well as the asset management of hotel properties that the Group owns. Ms Wee also founded and manages the Group’s lifestyle brands such as St. Gregory and Si Chuan Dou Hua Restaurant. Craig Bond Chief Operating Officer Craig focuses on driving operational excellence across the group by establishing strategic routes to meet commercial and organizational objectives. Throughout his career, he has spearheaded growth and operations across various international markets and his deep understanding of the hospitality sector and cultural nuances enables him to drive consistent excellence across the guest journey. Celine Du Chief Commercial and Marketing Officer Celine oversees PPHG's commercial strategy and performance across both corporate and property levels across its portfolio of Pan Pacific, PARKROYAL COLLECTION, and PARKROYAL brands. With over three decades of experience across some of the world’s most prestigious luxury hotel brands, Celine brings deep expertise in driving revenue growth, strengthening brand equity, and building high-performing teams. Valerie Foo Senior Vice-President, Finance Valerie Foo’s career spans more than 20 years of varied experience in financial reporting and management. As the Senior Vice President, Finance of Pan Pacific Hotels Group, Valerie is responsible for all of the company’s financial functions, including reporting, corporate finance and treasury. She also oversees the information technology and investment functions. Andreas Sungaimin Senior Vice-President, People & Culture Andreas focuses on talent acquisition and management, learning and development, service culture, employee engagement, as well as compensation and benefits. He has over 30 years of human resources experience in the hospitality industry as well as from private and public sector organisations. Kate Loh Vice President, Development (Head of Development) Kate leads the strategic growth of the group, driving efforts to secure new management opportunities and expand the portfolio. She brings extensive experience in development planning, feasibility studies, and project management across the Asia Pacific region.
